boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Harding University
boards.description: Ten under-21 food stops in Searcy with directly documented service at or after 10 p.m.; confirm same-day and holiday hours before leaving campus.

cards.title: Late Night at the Caf
cards.subtitle: On-campus food through 10:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday
cards.notes: Stay on campus for the documented Late Night period; check the dining app for that evening’s menu before heading over.
cards.short_summary: The university’s own weekday late-service option requires no off-campus trip.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding’s undergraduate handbook lists University Dining Hall Late Night service from 7:30–10:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Late Night is listed Monday–Thursday, 7:30–10:30 p.m.; campus all-campus curfew begins at midnight Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Race Avenue Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: A nightly midnight closing on East Race Avenue
cards.notes: Use this for a straightforward East Race run, and verify holiday hours on the location page before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A seven-night midnight closing makes this one of the later documented Race Avenue counters.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Searcy page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–midnight every day at 1707 E. Race Ave.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 12:00 a.m. Monday–Sunday; the official page warns that holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Carryout Until 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: Late carryout and delivery at 3528 E. Race Ave
cards.notes: Order before the posted cutoff and plan around Harding’s curfew; the official page supports both carryout and delivery.
cards.short_summary: This East Race location documents the same 1 a.m. cutoff throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingstop’s official location page lists carryout and delivery from 10 a.m.–1 a.m. daily at 3528 E. Race Ave.
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery are listed until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Saturday; Harding residential curfew may require an earlier return.

cards.entity_name: Domino's Pizza at 3511 E. Race Ave
cards.title: Pizza at the Midnight Mark
cards.subtitle: Delivery and carryout from the East Race storefront
cards.notes: Check the live location header before ordering because Domino’s says store hours vary; choose carryout or delivery as available.
cards.short_summary: An official store page documents ordering through midnight for this Searcy address.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page identifies the Searcy store at 3511 E. Race Ave., Suite 700, and shows it open until midnight when fetched.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 3511 E. Race Ave. Ste 700 | Domino's in Searcy
cards.access_notes: The official location page showed “Today Until 12:00 AM” when fetched and instructs customers to check its Hours section for current store hours.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 2513 W. Beebe Capps Expy
cards.title: The 3 A.M. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: West-side drive-thru service beyond campus curfew
cards.notes: Treat this as a drive-thru trip and leave enough time to return within Harding’s curfew; dine-in closes much earlier.
cards.short_summary: The west Searcy location separates a 3 a.m. drive-thru from earlier dining-room access.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–3 a.m. daily at 2513 W. Beebe Capps Expy.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Searcy, AR — 2513 W Beebe Capps Expy
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 3:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours are earlier, and Harding curfew limits practical student access.

cards.entity_name: Sonic Drive-In at 1201 N. Maple St
cards.title: North Maple After Ten
cards.subtitle: A drive-in closing later on Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Use the weekend window for the latest service, and confirm the chamber listing before leaving because posted hours can change.
cards.short_summary: The North Maple drive-in extends its documented closing to 11 p.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Searcy Regional Chamber lists this Sonic at 1201 N. Maple St. until 10:30 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed closing is 10:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and 11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Dairy Queen at 708 E. Beebe Capps Expy
cards.title: Custard Before Eleven
cards.subtitle: Friday and Saturday service until 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Save this stop for Friday or Saturday if you need the later window; the official page lists dine-in and drive-thru alike.
cards.short_summary: Weekend hours add an extra hour beyond this location’s usual 10 p.m. closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Dairy Queen’s official location page lists store, drive-thru, and dine-in service until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: DQ Grill & Chill Restaurant in Searcy, AR
cards.access_notes: Store, drive-thru, and dine-in are listed until 11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.entity_name: Zaxby's at 1303 E. Beebe Capps Expy
cards.title: Weekend Chicken Until Eleven
cards.subtitle: Friday and Saturday pickup and drive-thru service
cards.notes: Aim for Friday or Saturday to use the later closing, and check whether pickup or drive-thru fits your return schedule.
cards.short_summary: This Beebe Capps location documents an 11 p.m. weekend extension for two service modes.
cards.evidence_claim: Zaxby’s official Searcy page lists pickup and drive-thru hours until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Zaxbys Searcy AR — Fried Chicken & Fast Food
cards.access_notes: Pickup and drive-thru are listed until 11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.entity_name: Slim Chickens at 402 E. Beebe Capps
cards.title: An Every-Night 11 P.M. Option
cards.subtitle: Consistent late service on Beebe Capps
cards.notes: Choose this when a consistent closing time matters, but recheck the chamber listing before departure for operational changes.
cards.short_summary: The posted schedule keeps the same 11 p.m. closing across all seven days.
cards.evidence_claim: The Searcy Regional Chamber lists Slim Chickens at 402 E. Beebe Capps as open from 10 a.m.–11 p.m. Sunday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The chamber listing gives 10:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. hours every day of the week.

cards.entity_name: Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers at 2812 E. Race Ave
cards.title: Friday Custard at Eleven
cards.subtitle: A weekend-only late window on East Race Avenue
cards.notes: Plan this run for Friday or Saturday, when the chamber’s schedule extends service one hour beyond the weekday closing.
cards.short_summary: The East Race custard-and-burger counter stays open later on two weekend nights.
cards.evidence_claim: The Searcy Regional Chamber lists Freddy’s at 2812 E. Race Ave. until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed closing is 11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

warnings: Late-night access may be constrained by Harding’s documented residential and all-campus curfews: midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
Restaurant and holiday hours can change; users should recheck each linked source on the day of travel.
The Domino’s source displays a live daily closing rather than a full weekly schedule, so its midnight availability should always be reconfirmed.
